programs.description: Jay, an enthusiastic traveller, leaves his house to explore different parts of the country. On his way to Goa, he befriends Rajashree, a young woman who has also fled her home.
Gajanan, a 33-year-old school teacher, undergoes a life-changing experience after he comes across his student and three women.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.
Shekhar, an engineer, wishes to marry his lover Sangeeta, who is a doctor. However, Shekhar's family is against their union due to an event associated with his family.
Narayan, a small-time thief, gets arrested for murder after being trapped. Shama, an amateur lawyer, takes up Narayan's case and also falls in love with him.
Jaggu, a recovery agent who is burdened with family responsibilities, forms a team and goes to London to find Neeraj Shah, a businessman who is absconding after duping a bank in India.
Changu and Mangu, brothers from a rich family, discover that Changu has a twin brother living in South India. A series of mishaps ensue due to mistaken identities.
